description.value: Fairmont Hot Springs Pools is the signature natural geothermal swimming attraction of Fairmont Hot Springs Resort, a year-round Rocky Mountain resort in BC's Kootenay region. The broader resort complex includes multiple dining options, a spa, golf, and ski access, making it a substantial destination stop rather than a quick roadside break. Its location along the Columbia Valley corridor places it within reach of several well-travelled touring routes.

address.value: 5225 Fairmont Resort Road, Fairmont Hot Springs, BC V0B 1L1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The specific OSM URL for the pools page returns a 404, but subpages (FAQ, About Us, Contact & Location, Notice of Accessibility) confirm the resort is real, operational, and actively taking bookings. The accessibility page explicitly lists 'Public Washrooms' as an accessible feature, confirming washrooms. Multiple dining venues (Bear's Paw Bar & Grill, Steamers Café, etc.) are listed on the website, confirming food on site. No explicit mention of bike parking, showers, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
